When reporting bugs, please follow the guidelines in this template. This helps identify the problem precisely and thus enables contributors to fix it faster.

- Write a descriptive issue title above.
- The golden rule is to **always open one issue for one bug.** If you notice several bugs and want to report them, make sure to create one new issue for each of them.
- Search [open](https://github.com/Entertainment-Visual-Art-Studio/Screenfix/issues) and [closed](https://github.com/Entertainment-Visual-Art-Studio/Screenfix/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed) issues to ensure it has not already been reported. If you don't find a relevant match or if you're unsure, don't hesitate **to open a new issue**. The lead Dev will handle it from there if it's a duplicate.
- If the bug is specific to one or more specific platform, you have to give all the details about that **software and the version you're actually using.**

Feel free to add screenshot too to prove your point !
